raw_segments.text: You have conceived my meaning perfectly, and if I mistake not, what you failed to apprehend
before is now made clear to you that poetry and mythology are, in some cases, wholly imitative.
Instances of this are supplied by tragedy and comedy.
There is likewise the opposite style, in which the poet is the only speaker.
Of this the dithyram affords the best example, and the combination of both is found in epic
and in several other styles of poetry.
Do I take you with me?
